#FullStackDev #GamingTech #CloudOptimization  
At NovaGame Studios, I build scalable, high-performance systems that power next-gen games. Over the past three years, I’ve architected solutions that cut AWS costs by 30% using CloudFormation, while ensuring 99.9% uptime for our multiplayer servers. My Kubernetes clusters handle 50k+ concurrent users, and Terraform automates infrastructure updates across 12 regions—no more manual spreadsheets.  

When it comes to CI/CD, I’ve slashed deployment times from hours to minutes with custom Jenkins pipelines, slashing rollback risks by 70%. Docker containers? I’ve made them the backbone of our microservices, slashing startup times by 40%. MongoDB handles millions of user sessions daily, and my REST APIs? They’re the glue between our Node.js backend and React frontends—built with TypeScript, of course.  

Python scripts automate 80% of our devops tasks, and I’ve optimized web performance to load complex game assets in under 2 seconds. Let’s make gaming faster, smarter, and more scalable—one line of code at a time. Ready to level up? 🚀
